summary: Smoke test after adding Pool registration panel & registerInPool(). App boots, all 6 nav tabs work, Pool tab renders no-wallet empty state correctly, register panel is properly gated (not shown when disconnected), 'WHAT STAYS VISIBLE' panel still present, backend /api/status, /api/pubkey, /api/ledger all 200 OK. No new JS/React errors from new code.
critical_code_review_comments: registerInPool() looks correct — uses account.execute() (starknet.js WalletAccountV6 standard invoke), with addInvokeTransaction fallback, and USER_REFUSED / ALREADY_REGISTERED classification. However the ALREADY_REGISTERED regex only matches the string 'already_registered'; some Cairo contracts revert with different literals like 'AlreadyRegistered' or 'CALLER_ALREADY_REGISTERED' — consider a looser match (/already.?registered/i) so users get the friendly toast instead of the generic register_failed.

PrivacyScreen register panel is gated only on `connected && sepolia` — it will always appear (even after the user has successfully registered). Consider persisting a 'registered' flag (localStorage keyed by pool+address) so the panel auto-hides after a successful register accept, or shows a subtle 'Registered ✓' state. Current UX forces the user to guess whether to click.

The register button doesn't consume the pool fee display or block on maturity, which is correct; but it also doesn't check `capable` — registration is a plain public invoke so this is fine, but worth a code comment noting register is intentionally allowed for non-STRK20-capable wallets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real Ready wallet flow (register/shield) cannot be exercised in the sandbox. Focus of this iteration was: (a) new register panel is correctly gated behind connected && sepolia, and (b) no runtime errors from the new registerInPool import/export chain. Both confirmed. Only console noise observed was one net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED (unrelated resource, not from new code).
rca of the issue: Original user report: pool Shield 'doesnt work or trigger register'. RCA per main agent: STRK20 pool contract exposes an explicit register() entrypoint that Ready wallet does not auto-invoke; deposit reverts if caller is not registered. Mitigation applied by main agent: expose registerInPool() in wallet lib and add an explicit 'Register with pool' button on the Pool tab before Shield. Verified panel + button are wired to context.starknet.register().
